title: Flaky: ui/packages/auth AuthProvider.test.tsx "a 401 on an API call re-checks the session" fails its identity-clears assertion after ~10 s in Test UI (10/16)
body:
domain:ui#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSf5S4Kkc7aL9t5DSd

Filing gate: ① a CI flake with a named instance, seen by `domain:ui#1` on PR #32706, a diff that touches no `ui/packages/auth` path. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.

## What failed

- Run 43204347096, attempt 1, job `Test UI (10/16)` 131136744090, head `546cabb93`.
- `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/AuthProvider.test.tsx` › "a 401 on an API call re-checks the session (objectstack#32138)" › "the server answers \"no session\": identity clears, so the guard can send the visitor to sign in".
- `AssertionError: expected 'true' to be 'false' // Object.is equality`, reported at 10018 ms.
- The same job passed on its one re-run (attempt 2, job 131146926948) with no change to the head.
- The log around it carries many `[AuthProvider] Failed to load organizations: TypeError: client.listOrganizations is not a function` lines, which may be from sibling tests.

## Reach

Any PR whose Test UI matrix runs that shard: a red that is not the PR's. It costs a re-run, a reader's time, and a queue ejection if it lands in `merge_group`.

## Reading (not measured, for the claimer)

The duration sits at the 10 s `waitFor` / test budget edge, so the assertion likely read before the re-check settled. ⛔ No skip, retry wrapper or quarantine: make the test own the timing of the session re-check, and repeat the file under the shard's concurrency.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue "AuthProvider.test" 401 re-checks session` → 0 hits.
